environmentNotes: Scope: 24 inventory cases (EXPL 001-005, FILT 001-009, CMP 001-010) + 1 gap case (TC_EXPL_006). No approval-gated actions in this module; nothing excluded.

cases.actual: Explore tab: category chips Luxury (default, selected) / Premium / Deluxe, filter icon, brand chips (Volvo Bus India, Ashok Leyland, SML Isuzu, Eicher India, Daimler India, Force India, Tata Motors...), Vehicle Comparison card with Compare Vehicles, All Vehicles 2-column grid (6 Luxury vehicles).

Premium shows only Premium vehicles (16 Seater Premium Urbania, 21 Seater Premium AC...). Deluxe shows No vehicles found matching your criteria. although 33/40 Seater Deluxe Coaches and Sedan (Delux badge) exist in the fleet. BUG-VLIST-001 still reproducible on app-release_5Oct26.apk.

Brand chips scroll horizontally (Volvo Bus India ... Eicher India, Daimler India, Force India, Tata Motors). Luxury + Volvo Bus India -> only Volvo models (49 Seater Luxury 9600, 45 Seater Luxury 9600...); Luxury + Force India -> 9 and 12 Seater Luxury Urbania; Luxury + Ashok Leyland -> empty state (no Ashok Luxury vehicle). Observation: a selected brand chip cannot be deselected by tapping it again (only Reset Filters clears it) - logged as TC_EXPL_006.
Every vehicle card shows a stray value 100 below the seater/price row with no label or icon (e.g. 45 Seater Luxury BharatBenz, 49 Seater Luxury 9600 Volvo). OBS-19 still present.

Tapping the 9 Seater Luxury Urbania card opens its Vehicle Details (9 Seats, Diesel, Automatic, Monocoque Van; Pricing Local Rs 9,500 = card Starts From Rs 9,500). Back returns to Explore with the brand filter retained.

Filter sheet: header Filters with X; groups Vehicle Type (Midi Coach, Full-Size Coach, Sedan, MPV, Passenger Van, Mini Coach, Luxury Van, Single-Axle Luxury Coach, Multi-Axle Luxury Coach, SUVs), AC (AC / Non AC), Seat Type (1+1, 2+1, 2+2, 2+3), Passenger Seater Capacity (7 ... 60+, Other), Vehicle Type (Body Type), Amenities / Features, Luggage Capacity; sticky Reset All / Apply Filters footer while scrolling.
Luxury + Leathered Seats -> Apply: grid narrowed to 1 vehicle (45 Seater Luxury Volvo).
Luxury + AC + 2+2 + 40-45 Seater -> 3 vehicles, all 45 Seater Luxury with AC icon (BharatBenz, 9600 Volvo, Volvo); the 49-seat Volvo and 9/12-seat Urbanias are excluded - AND across groups works.

OR within Vehicle Type: Luxury Van + Multi-Axle Luxury Coach -> 2 vehicles, one of each type (49 Seater Luxury 9600 Volvo, 9 Seater Luxury Urbania). The case data Sedan + SUVs returns the empty state because the Luxury category chip is always applied and Sedan/SUV are not Luxury (Deluxe chip broken - BUG-VLIST-001).

With Leathered Seats applied, the filter icon on Explore shows no badge/count; the active-filter count (1/2/3) is shown only inside the open sheet (next to Filters title and on Apply Filters). OBS-20 still present.
Reset All inside the sheet clears every selection, closes the sheet and restores the full Luxury list (6 vehicles); empty-state Reset Filters button behaves the same.
Leathered Seats applied; opened sheet, added AC (count 2), closed with X -> list unchanged; reopening shows count 1 and AC unselected - previous applied state retained.
Luxury + Force India + Leathered Seats (no match) -> No vehicles found matching your criteria. with a Reset Filters button.
Leathered Seats filter applied -> Home tab -> Explore tab: same filtered list (1 vehicle) shown; filters persist across tab switch.

cases.scenario: Selected brand chip can be deselected by tapping it again
cases.preconditions: Explore with a brand chip selected
cases.steps: 1. Tap Force India 2. Tap Force India again
cases.expected: Second tap deselects the brand and restores the unfiltered category list
cases.actual: Second tap leaves Force India selected and the list filtered; the only way to clear the brand is Reset Filters (which also clears all other filters).
Compare Vehicles -> compare mode: Current select (0/2), button changes to Select 2 Vehicles to Compare, Cancel Comparison link shown.
Tapping 45 Seater Luxury BharatBenz and 49 Seater Luxury 9600 Volvo highlights both cards, counter Current select (2/2), button becomes Compare Vehicles (enabled).

With 2 selected, tapping a third card (45 Seater Luxury 9600 Volvo) silently replaces the most recently selected vehicle (49 Seater) - no message, counter stays 2/2. Neither blocked with a message nor replaces the oldest selection; the user is not told a selection was dropped.
Tapping a selected card deselects it: counter 2/2 -> 1/2, button reverts to Select 2 Vehicles to Compare.
With 1 selected, tapping Select 2 Vehicles to Compare shows dialog Siddaganga Travels - Select two vehicles from the grid to compare. (OK); comparison not opened.
Compare mode with 1 vehicle selected -> Cancel Comparison: selection cleared, counter and Cancel link hidden, normal Compare Vehicles button restored.

Vehicle Comparison (45 Seater Luxury 9600 Volvo vs 49 Seater Luxury 9600 Volvo): all expected rows present (capacity, body type, local base rate, outstation rate Rs 85/km vs Rs 120/km, daily min km, driver allowance, mileage, fuel type, toll/parking, night charge, AC type, seat type, luggage capacity, model year, condition, suspension, amenities), but Mileage, Fuel type, Toll/Parking, Luggage capacity, Model year and Condition are a dash for both vehicles (Fuel type is Diesel on Vehicle Details). BUG-CMP-001 still present.
CURRENT tag on 45 Seater; tapping the 49 Seater card moves CURRENT to it.
With CURRENT = 49 Seater Luxury 9600 Volvo, View Full Details opens Vehicle Details of that vehicle (49 Seats, L49NV); back returns to Explore.

49 Seater: comparison Local base rate Rs 22,500 = details Local Rs 22,500 and Outstation Rs 120/km = details + Rs 120/km, but details Outstation price is Rs 60,000 /day + Rs 120/km while the comparison Outstation rate row omits the Rs 60,000/day component - outstation rate not shown consistently.
